## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The command should preserve a single progress message when adopting an existing setting; this change duplicates it. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds adoption records and setting-count audit metadata to returned plans while retaining adoption progress output. It adds tests for audit records and empty input.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Emit each adoption message only once — With `current = incoming = {"theme": "dark"}`, `run` emits `Adopted theme` twice. You retain the progress emission and add an adoption record that `app/cli.py:9` emits again because its filter skips only audit records. — Users receive duplicate progress messages whenever the command processes an existing setting, making one adoption appear to happen twice. — Fix: Preserve planner progress output, exclude adoption records from command rendering, and extend `test_adoption_progress` to exercise `run`.
